name: Audit Export and Verification
description: Export audit trails in standard formats. Include verification tools that prove the export is complete and untampered.
acceptanceCriteria: Export produces standard formats (JSON, CSV, and a canonical format).
Export includes a manifest with checksums for every exported record.
Export verification tool validates the manifest against the exported data.
Verification tool confirms chain integrity and completeness (no missing entries).
External auditors can run the verification tool without access to the live system.
